import html from typing import List # Pre‑defined template for forum posts. # It contains placeholders: {title}, {body} and {points} FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
    {points}
""" def _escape_and_strip_markdown(text: str) -> str: """ Escapes HTML special characters and removes basic markdown syntax that could be used for injection. This is a minimal approach to mitigate CWE‑707 by ensuring the output is well‑formed HTML. """ # Escape all characters that have special meaning in HTML escaped = html.escape(text) # Very simple markdown cleanup: remove asterisks, hyphens and underscores # that might be used for bold/italic formatting. This prevents attempts to # inject malformed HTML via markdown. cleaned = ( escaped.replace("*", "") .replace("_", "") .replace("-", "") ) return cleaned def compile_post(subject: str, text: str, highlights: List[str]) -> str: """ Assemble a forum post from the given subject, body text and discussion points. Parameters ---------- subject : str The title of the forum post. text : str Main body content of the post. highlights : list[str] Discussion points supplied in markdown format. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready to be rendered in a forum. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the inputs are not strings or if highlights is not a list. """ # Basic type checks if not isinstance(subject, str): raise ValueError("subject must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise ValueError("text must be a string") if not isinstance(highlights, list) or any(not isinstance(h, str) for h in highlights): raise ValueError("highlights must be a list of strings") # Sanitize title and body safe_title = _escape_and_strip_markdown(subject) safe_body = _escape_and_strip_markdown(text) # Build the discussion points list safe_points_items = [] for point in highlights: cleaned_point = _escape_and_strip_markdown(point) safe_points_items.append(f"
  • {cleaned_point}
    • ") # Join all list items safe_points = "\n".join(safe_points_items) # Format the final post using the template formatted_post = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, body=safe_body, points=safe_points ) return formatted_post.strip()
